buyTicket().details: Reverts if the phase is not Open or if the exact ticket price is not sent.

claimPrize().details: Applies nonReentrant modifier. Reverts if the caller is not the recorded winner.

closeSale().details: Only callable by contract owner. Reverts if no participants have joined.

commitHash(bytes32).details: Only callable by owner. Transitions the state to the Committed phase.

params._hash: The keccak256 hash of the secret string.

params.initialTicketPrice: The cost to buy a single ticket in wei.

returns.participantCount: The total number of tickets sold.
returns.phase: The current phase of the lottery.
returns.pool: The total accumulated prize pool in wei.
returns.price: The exact cost of a single ticket.
returns.winningAddress: The address of the winner (address(0) if not yet drawn).

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

revealAndDraw(bytes32).details: Verifies the secret against the committedHash. Calculates the winner and transitions to Drawn.

params._secret: The raw string or bytes that was previously hashed.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

buyTicket().notice: Allows a user to purchase a ticket.

claimPrize().notice: Allows the winner to withdraw the prize pool.

closeSale().notice: Closes the ticket sale phase, preventing further purchases.

constructor.notice: Initializes the lottery with a specific ticket price.

getLotteryInfo().notice: Returns comprehensive data about the current lottery state.

revealAndDraw(bytes32).notice: Owner reveals the secret to draw the winner deterministically.
